name: Evan Shi
headline: Senior Software Engineer
summary: Software engineer with 6+ years of experience building backend systems for banking, telecom and healthcare, including three years at State Street in an English-speaking team. I now build and run my own AI products, and I'm preparing to study for a master's degree and work as a software engineer in New Zealand.

highlights: Build and run two AI SaaS products on my own, from model pipelines to payments and deployment. Revenue is [public and verified](/revenue).
Lead developer on an institutional digital-asset trading platform built as Java microservices on AWS.
Led a billing audit system for a mobile operator with 10M+ subscribers, and made a 5M-messages-a-day data service 40% faster.
Built pathology software used by six hospitals and led a small team of developers.

achievements: Lanqiao Cup programming contest, second prize
